Name: Hosah, Porter
Summary: Porter before the ark, son of Jeduthun's line in chapter 16, and father of Simri in chapter 26.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 16:38; 1 Chronicles 26:10: Porter before the ark, son of Jeduthun's line in chapter 16, and father of Simri in chapter 26.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hosah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
